I played through the game twice and never had any serious performance issues, in fact, I don't believe it ever crashed on me either. I agree that Rocksteady should have been in charge of the PC port from the start to avoid all this, but I think people are blowing the whole thing out of proportion a bit.

I have played through on almost exactly the same spec system. Thinking back, I can't actually remember this game crashing on me once. I was beginning to think it was just me!

My pet theory is that the last ( 2 or 3) generation(s) of games have all required lots of GFX grunt, but haven't required much from the CPU, so most gaming rigs have been fine running with an underpowered CPU. My rig is primarily for animation and music production, so I put a lot of money into CPU and memory as well, and some games are starting to need this raw CPU power as well as the GPU.
